strings.options.external_mod_strip_link.tooltip: Hide and restore registered appearances only when an external mod unequips and re-equips actual gear. Manual inventory changes are ignored.
strings.options.external_mod_strip_link.disabled: External strip and redress actions do not affect registered appearances.
strings.options.external_mod_strip_link.mod_sett: Uses the external mod's configured slots and contextual tokens to hide and restore registered appearances.
strings.options.external_mod_strip_link.vanilla_: Follows actual vanilla gear stripped and restored by external mods, hiding appearances classified to the corresponding vanilla slots.

strings.options.special_effect_protected_slots.t: Actual equipment in the selected slots always remains visible, and appearance registration for those slots is blocked.
strings.options.shield_appearance_slot.tooltip: Enable this option to use the shield slot for appearances. When disabled, the actual shield remains visible and appearance registration is blocked.
strings.options.toggle_capture.title: Change Toggle UI Button
strings.options.toggle_capture.body: Press a keyboard combination or gamepad button. For gamepad, release one button for a single binding, or hold the first button and press a second button for a chord.
strings.options.toggle_capture.hint: Press T to reset to default (F6). Press Escape to cancel.
strings.options.toggle_capture.invalid: Choose a valid key or gamepad button combination.

strings.workbench.appearance_protected.tooltip: This item contains a protected special-effect slot, or shield appearances are disabled. Actual equipment remains visible, new registration is blocked, and an existing registered appearance stays inactive until protection is removed.
strings.workbench.toolbar.reset_all.tooltip: Delete base registered appearances in the current workbench view. Conditional appearances and actual equipped items are not changed.

strings.conditions.clauses.or_group_tooltip: In Skyrim, consecutive OR clauses are evaluated as a grouped block before surrounding AND clauses. Example: A AND B OR C AND D becomes A AND (B OR C) AND D.

strings.equipment.no_addons_warning: This item has no armor add-ons, so Skyrim Fitting System cannot use it for DAVE row or override variants.
strings.help.gear.1: Use this tab to override a specific equipped gear piece.
strings.help.gear.2: Browse individual armor pieces from the equipment catalog.
strings.help.gear.3: Double-click to register this item's appearance. If no matching actual equipment is equipped, Skyrim Fitting System creates a slot-based registered appearance row instead.
strings.help.outfits.1: Browse full outfits from plugins in the catalog.
strings.help.outfits.2: Double-click to replace the selected actor's entire base registered appearance set with this outfit. Actual equipment is not equipped or unequipped from this UI.
strings.help.kits.1: Browse kits loaded from data/interface/SkyrimFittingSystem/user/kits. Legacy Modex kits are also shown when present.
strings.help.kits.2: Kits behave like outfits: double-click replaces the selected actor's entire base registered appearance set so the result matches the kit. The context menu can apply with a specific condition or delete the kit.
strings.help.kits.3: Kits that refer to non-existent items are not shown.
strings.help.slots.1: Use this tab to create a target for a specific equipment slot, even when no real item is currently equipped there.
strings.help.slots.2: Slot targets let a registered appearance apply later when matching gear occupies that equipment slot.
strings.help.slots.3: Skyrim Fitting System resolves fitting rows against the slots declared on the armor form itself. Armor addon slots are still shown in item details for troubleshooting, and are used only as a fallback when an armor form declares no slots.
strings.help.slots.4: Double-click to add a slot target to the workbench, or use the context menu to add it manually.
strings.help.conditions.1: Use this tab to define reusable condition sets for Skyrim Fitting System.
strings.help.conditions.2: Conditions are built from condition functions joined by AND and OR operators, plus a shared display color so you can recognize them later.
strings.help.conditions.3: Double-click a condition to edit it, use Add New to create a fresh one, or drag a condition to a workbench row so that row only applies when the condition is met.
strings.help.host_toggle.docked: Pop the catalog back into the main window.
strings.help.host_toggle.popout: Pop the catalog out into its own window.
strings.help.show_all_slots.1: When unchecked, only slots that currently have equipped items are shown.
strings.help.show_all_slots.2: Enable this to browse every supported equipment slot, including slots that are currently empty.
strings.conditions.custom.title: Custom Conditions
strings.conditions.custom.drag_hint: Drag a condition card onto a registered appearance.
strings.conditions.builtin.weapon.description: Applies while a weapon is drawn.
strings.conditions.sample.city_life.description: Applies in cities while out of combat.
strings.conditions.sample.dungeon_exploration.de: Applies in dungeons while in combat.
strings.strip_link.title: Strip Link Settings — Shared by All Actors
strings.strip_link.mode.label: Link Mode
strings.strip_link.help: Registered appearances hide when linked actual gear is removed and return when it is equipped again.
strings.strip_link.help.modding: All actors · Mod-Configured Slot Linking: hides actual gear and registered appearances according to each mod's configured slot values.
strings.strip_link.help.vanilla: All actors · Automatic Vanilla-Slot Linking: analyzes mod outfit keywords and automatically matches them to vanilla equipment slots.
strings.strip_link.help.direct: All actors · Direct Slot Editing: every slot defaults to the same slot; choose an explicit target or No Linking for each card.
strings.options.external_mod_strip_link.tooltip:
Mod-Configured Slot Linking: follows each mod's configured slots and allows per-slot exceptions.
Automatic Vanilla-Slot Linking: analyzes outfit keywords for automatic matching and allows per-slot exceptions.
Direct Slot Editing: choose either linking method as the base and edit only the slots that need exceptions.
strings.options.external_mod_strip_link.disabled: External strip/redress actions do not affect registered appearances.
strings.options.external_mod_strip_link.mod_sett: Use the slots and tokens configured by the external mod.
strings.options.external_mod_strip_link.vanilla_: Automatically match each appearance to a vanilla equipment slot.
strings.options.external_mod_strip_link.custom.t: Choose Mod-Configured or Automatic Vanilla-Slot Linking as the base, then edit only the appearance slots that need exceptions.
strings.options.character_position.tooltip: In third person, place the character beside the SFS window. Right-drag the character area to rotate the player; the original camera and facing direction are restored when SFS closes.
strings.options.special_effect_protected_slots.t: Actual equipment in selected slots always remains visible, and appearance registration for those slots is blocked.
strings.options.shield_appearance_slot.tooltip: When enabled, the shield slot can contain registered appearances. When disabled, the actual shield remains visible and appearance registration is blocked.
